summary: Retention-sweep fix shipped: terminal-status snapshots make graph nodes survive cleanupPeriodDays GC of ~/.claude/tasks/. overlay.js: new `snapshots` field + setSnapshot() (subject/description/status/blockedBy/owner/metadata + snapshotted_at). native-tasks.js: new readTask(); aggregateWorkspace(ws, snapshots?) falls back to snapshot nodes when native file/session is gone (native wins when present; {session}/{id} keys intact). daemon.js: snapshotNative() helper; called on done/tested/failed/canceled in /overlay/status and on /supersede cancel; aggregateCached passes overlay snapshots. README persistence claim corrected (durable→bounded by sweep, mitigation documented). Native dir stays read-only (writeStatus unchanged). Verified: node --check ×3, full test suite 32/32 pass, e2e script (snapshot → delete native dir → node still aggregates with label/deps/status; no dup when native present; no-arg back-compat). Caveat: running daemon needs restart to pick up the change; pre-sweep-completed tasks have no snapshot until their next status write.
